owner_creation.analysis: sigs: The exported c_int owns pending signal-notification bits; handlers OR in event flags and psignals copies them for later work.
owner_creation.invariant: Event metadata owns no screen, filter or queue memory.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

aliases_escapes.analysis: sigs: Ordinary input/output code reads the integer by value, but its bits provide no lifetime protection for the shared owners that handlers also mutate.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Notification observation is not a borrow-retirement proof.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

callback_targets.analysis: sigs: Handler code updates the value directly and psignals dispatches fixed branches; the mask is not itself a stored function pointer table.
callback_targets.invariant: Event bits must be kept distinct from callback ownership.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

invalidation.analysis: sigs: psignals sets sigs to zero after its snapshot; nested delivery can modify a shared raw value independently of the processing snapshot.
invalidation.invariant: Clearing notifications requires a coherent delivery protocol.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

mutation_commit.analysis: sigs: The OR/snapshot/clear sequence is not atomic Rust event extraction; no owner-wide commit includes direct handler filter or queue effects.
mutation_commit.invariant: Raw notification updates are not a transactional queue.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

release_pair.analysis: sigs: Clearing a bit releases no external resource; the dispatched code may separately clean terminal or filter state and must own that action.
release_pair.invariant: Notification consumption cannot release arbitrary owner data.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

error_cleanup.analysis: sigs: A zero mask does not prove no handler-side mutation happened or no callback error occurred; it cannot serve as a cleanup-success receipt.
error_cleanup.invariant: Missing bits are not evidence of completed owner recovery.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.

signals_handoff.analysis: sigs: The representation is a mutable translated global with cross-handler/main access, retained under M0-MEM-001 alongside the separate signal findings.
signals_handoff.invariant: A raw signal mask is not an approved event-loop handoff.
limitations: This records notification ownership/ordering concerns without claiming a new observed signal-loss failure or changing handler source.
